notes:
## Changes

- Combine U and V synthesis into one GPU dispatch for compatible 8-bit YUV420 clips using shader 23. The two planes share motion-field sampling.
- Add regression tests for selecting the paired chroma path. All 2,400 reference output frames matched byte for byte, including synthesized frames.

Extract the ZIP and open Open SVPflow.app on an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later. See the README for setup and compatibility details.
